decisions.decision: CTE O&M Contract extension approved to November to allow time for contract advertising and request for bid
decisions.quote: bill gave them an extension of time until november and it was due to be signed by today. cte signed off on the extension, and it was just waiting for the town manager's approval.

decisions.decision: Privilege Fees policy to continue charging one-half of the Betterment as recommended by Town Counsel
decisions.quote: town counsel recommended staying with charging ½ of the betterment as a privilege fee, which is what they have been doing.

decisions.decision: Commissioners agreed to consider asking contractors to check for leaks and issues in manholes they open
decisions.quote: scott asked if they will still consider asking contractors to check for any leaks/issues in manholes they open and the other commissioners agreed it would be a good idea.

decisions.decision: Accept resignation of Arthur Katis from the Sewer Commission
decisions.quote: the commissioners all thanked him for his time on the commission and hope he can return in the future.

budget_items.topic: 100 Laurel Lane sewer connection project costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Project completed with labor costs of $8,200 and materials costs of $2,000, totaling $10,200, well under the $20,000 budget
budget_items.quote: andrew replied it was about $8,200 for labor and $2,000 for materials.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Connection Fee of $50,462.96 assessed for townhouses based on original betterment of approximately $11,000
budget_items.quote: the connection fee will be $50,462.96, based on the original betterment of around $11,000.
